about: IELTS Writing Task 2 questions written for MyVocab, in the real test's question types.
instructions: Write about the following topic. Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words.

prompts.prompt: Some people believe that university education should be free for everyone. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Some people think that children should be allowed to use smartphones from an early age, while others believe this is harmful. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
More and more people are working from home instead of in an office. Do the advantages of this development outweigh the disadvantages?
Traffic congestion is becoming a serious problem in many large cities. What are the causes of this problem, and what measures could be taken to solve it?
The best way to protect the environment is for individuals to change their behaviour, rather than for governments to make new laws. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Many people today do not get enough exercise. Why is this the case? What can be done to encourage people to be more active?
Some people believe that students should study a wide range of subjects at school, while others think they should focus on the subjects they are good at. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
Advertising aimed at children should be banned. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
International tourism has grown rapidly in recent decades. What are the advantages and disadvantages of this for the countries that tourists visit?
Large amounts of food are wasted every day in many countries. Why does this happen, and what can be done to reduce food waste?
Job satisfaction is more important than a high salary. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Some people prefer to live in a big city, while others prefer to live in the countryside. Discuss the advantages of both and give your own opinion.
Many people now get their news from social media rather than from newspapers or television. Why is this happening? Is it a positive or negative development?
Homework should be banned in primary schools. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
In many countries, people are choosing to have children later in life. What are the advantages and disadvantages of this trend?
Obesity is increasing among children in many parts of the world. What are the main causes, and what solutions can you suggest?
Some people think governments should spend money on exploring outer space, while others believe this money should be spent on problems on Earth. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
Museums and art galleries should be free for everyone to visit. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
In some countries, older people often live alone rather than with their families. Why is this? What problems can it cause?
Artificial intelligence is increasingly used to do jobs that people used to do. Do the advantages of this outweigh the disadvantages?
Private cars should be banned from city centres. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Some people believe that learning a foreign language is best done in childhood, while others think adults can learn just as well. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
Many young people find it difficult to buy their own home. What are the reasons for this, and how could the problem be addressed?
Professional athletes are paid far too much money. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
People spend more time looking at screens than ever before. What effects does this have on individuals? How can people achieve a better balance?
More universities now offer courses entirely online. What are the advantages and disadvantages of studying in this way?
Some people think that the best way to reduce crime is to give longer prison sentences, while others believe there are better ways. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
Governments should put a tax on sugary drinks and unhealthy food. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Plastic pollution is damaging the oceans. What are the causes of this problem, and what can individuals and governments do about it?
Many traditional skills and crafts are disappearing. Why is this happening? Is it important to keep these skills alive?
A four-day working week would be better for both workers and employers. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Some people choose to take a gap year to travel or work before going to university. What are the advantages and disadvantages of this?
Some people think that famous people have a responsibility to be good role models, while others believe their private lives are their own business. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
Teachers will become less important in the future because students can learn everything online. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Air pollution is a growing problem in many cities. What are the main causes, and what measures can be taken to improve air quality?
In many countries, people are moving from rural areas to cities. Why are people doing this? What problems does it cause?
Children should learn to write by hand rather than spending time learning to type. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Shopping online is replacing shopping in stores. Do the advantages of this trend outweigh the disadvantages?
Some people think that zoos are cruel and should be closed, while others believe they help to protect animals. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
Every young person should do a year of unpaid community service. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
